simple.meaning: to dash to pieces, or scatter
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to נָפַץ (H5310) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.

definitions.short: to dash to pieces, or scatter
definitions.usage: be beaten in sunder, break (in pieces), broken, dash (in pieces), cause to be discharged, dispersed, be overspread, scatter.

Pi`el dash to pieces: Perfect 3masculine singular וְנִמֵּץ consecutive Psa 137:9 with accusative infants ag.
